qs.ex: الـ PEEP العالي ممكن يعمل Pneumothorax.

qs.q: Which of the following ventilator alarms alerts the healthcare team to a potential issue with the patient's ventilation rate?
qs.ex: إنذار الـ High Frequency بينبّه لمشكلة في عدد النفسات.

qs.q: What is the recommended action if a patient is awake after ROSC?
opts: Transfer the patient to advanced critical care
qs.ex: بعد رجوع النبض (ROSC) والمريض صاحي: ينتقل لرعاية مركزة متقدمة.

qs.q: The PaO2/FiO2 ratio of 150 indicates:
qs.ex: الـ P/F بتاع 150 بين 100 و200، يعني moderate ARDS.

qs.q: A high-pressure ventilator alarm is most often caused by:
opts: Secretions, kinking or biting the tube
qs.ex: إنذار الـ High pressure: إفرازات، أو أنبوبة متنية، أو المريض عاضضها.

qs.q: Select ALL components of the VAP prevention bundle.
qs.ex: الـ VAP bundle: نرفع راس السرير 30–45°، ونوقف المهدئ يومياً، وعناية بالفم بالـ chlorhexidine، ووقاية من قرحة المعدة والجلطات.

qs.q: Lung-protective ventilation for ARDS uses a tidal volume of:
qs.ex: الـ Tidal volume في الـ ARDS من 4 لـ 6 مل/كجم.

qs.q: Suction is applied:
opts: Intermittently during withdrawal, ≤10–15 s, at 80–120 mmHg
qs.ex: الـ Suction: متقطع وإحنا بنسحب، أقل من 10–15 ثانية، بضغط 80–120.

qs.q: The treatment of choice for hemodynamically unstable (massive) pulmonary embolism is:
qs.ex: الـ PE الكبير مع هبوط في الدورة الدموية: Thrombolytic therapy.

qs.q: A patient who opens his eyes in response to speech, speaks inappropriate words and moves to localize pain site will receive a GCS of:
qs.ex: بيفتح عينه للكلام E3، وكلام غير مناسب V3، وبيحدد مكان الألم M5. المجموع 11.

qs.q: Decorticate posturing refers to abnormal:
opts: Rigid pronation of upper and lower extremities
Flexion of upper extremities and extension of lower extremities
qs.ex: الـ Decorticate: الدراعات مثنية لجوه على الصدر، والرجلين مفرودة. يعني فيه إصابة فوق جذع المخ.

qs.q: An acute stroke patient unable to sign the consent form because of inability to write most probably has:
qs.ex: مش قادر يكتب علشان يمضي: ده Agraphia.

qs.q: To prevent injury in a patient who has hemianopia, the nurse educates the patient to:
qs.ex: الـ Hemianopia معناها إنه فاقد نص مجال الرؤية، فنعلّمه يلف راسه ويمسح جوانب الأوضة بعينه.

qs.q: Signs and symptoms of meningeal irritation include all of the following EXCEPT:
qs.ex: علامات تهيّج السحايا: تيبس الرقبة والصداع، والحساسية من النور، وKernig وBrudzinski. أما الـ Aphasia والـ hemiparesis فعلامات بؤرية زي الجلطة.

qs.q: Which statement regarding psychomotor seizure is TRUE?
opts: They involve acts of random violence
qs.ex: الـ Psychomotor seizure (complex partial) بيبقى فيها سلوك متكرر زي مضغ أو لعب في الهدوم. إجابة مقترحة.

qs.q: Myasthenia gravis is mainly characterized by:
opts: Muscular weakness with exercise, improved with rest
qs.ex: الـ Myasthenia gravis: ضعف العضلات بيزيد مع المجهود وبيتحسن مع الراحة.

qs.q: While inserting a peripheral cannula on the right hand, the patient reaches over with his left hand to remove the noxious stimulus. This response is called:
qs.ex: مدّ إيده التانية علشان يشيل مصدر الألم: ده Localization (M5).

qs.q: You would allocate which Glasgow Coma Scale score for a patient who is in a coma?
qs.ex: الغيبوبة: GCS 8 أو أقل، والاختيار المناسب 6.

qs.q: You would allocate ...... GCS for a patient whose eyes are closed but open to speech, says words that don't make sense, can't obey commands and moves to locate a central stimulus.
qs.ex: عينه بتفتح للكلام E3، وكلام مش مفهوم المعنى V3، وبيحدد الألم M5. المجموع 11.

qs.q: A patient who experienced a transient ischemic attack is at high risk for:
qs.ex: الـ TIA إنذار بإن جلطة المخ (stroke) جاية.

qs.q: When assisting a patient with right-side hemiparesis and dysphagia with eating, it is very important to:
opts: Keep head of bed less than 30 degrees
Prevent aspiration by thinning the liquids
Check for food collected in the right cheek
Extend the patient's neck upward while eating
qs.ex: شلل في الناحية اليمين: الأكل بيتجمع في الخد اليمين ومبيحسش بيه، فلازم نشيك عليه علشان ميشرقش.

qs.q: Hemorrhagic stroke occurs as a result of which of the following?
qs.ex: الـ Hemorrhagic stroke سببه غالباً تمزق aneurysm أو ضغط عالي.

qs.q: Paralysis of the arm and leg on the same side of the body due to stroke or CVA refers to:
qs.ex: شلل الدراع والرجل في نفس الناحية: Hemiplegia.

qs.q: The acute phase of ischemic stroke ranges from:
qs.ex: المرحلة الحادة للـ ischemic stroke من 24 لـ 72 ساعة.

qs.q: When a patient with a stroke finds difficulty with writing, this is called:
qs.ex: صعوبة الكتابة: Agraphia.

qs.q: The clinical manifestations of a patient with hemorrhagic stroke include all of the following EXCEPT:
qs.ex: الـ hemorrhagic stroke بيعمل صداع شديد، وترجيع، وشلل نصفي، والضغط بيبقى عالي مش واطي. فالـ Hypotension هي الاستثناء.

qs.q: In promoting health maintenance for prevention of strokes, the highest risk for the most common type of stroke is present in:
opts: Those who are obese with high dietary fat intake
qs.ex: أعلى خطر لأشهر نوع (ischemic): الضغط العالي والسكر.

qs.q: A thrombus that develops in a cerebral artery does not always cause loss of neurologic function because:
opts: The body can dissolve atherosclerotic plaques as they form
Some brain tissues do not require constant blood supply
Circulation via the circle of Willis may provide blood supply to the affected area
Deficits occur only when major arteries are occluded
qs.ex: دايرة ويليس (circle of Willis) ممكن تعوّض الدم للمنطقة.

qs.q: A patient's facial numbness and inability to speak disappeared while awaiting examination and he requests discharge. Why should the nurse emphasize treatment before leaving?
opts: Symptoms will return and worsen in 24 hours
Transient deficits result from small hemorrhages that clot off
Probably a TIA, which is a sign of progressive cerebrovascular disease
qs.ex: الأعراض اختفت: غالباً TIA، وده إنذار بمرض في أوعية المخ، فلازم يتقيّم.

qs.q: What are characteristics of a stroke caused by intracerebral hemorrhage? (Select all that apply)
opts: Caused by rupture of a vessel
Commonly occurs during or after sleep
Creates a mass that compresses the brain
qs.ex: الـ intracerebral hemorrhage: تمزق في وعاء، والدم بيعمل كتلة بتضغط على المخ، والـ prognosis وحش.

qs.q: Which type of stroke is associated with endocardial disorders, has a rapid onset and is unrelated to activity?
qs.ex: الـ Embolic stroke: مرتبط بأمراض القلب (زي AF)، وبيبدأ فجأة، وملوش علاقة بالمجهود.

qs.q: What primarily determines the neurologic functions affected by a stroke?
opts: The brain area perfused by the affected artery
qs.ex: الوظايف اللي بتتأثر بتتحدد بمنطقة المخ اللي الشريان المسدود بيغذيها.

qs.q: The patient has a lack of comprehension of both verbal and written language. Which communication difficulty does he have?
qs.ex: مش فاهم الكلام المسموع ولا المكتوب: Receptive (Wernicke's) aphasia.

qs.q: A patient with left hemiplegia is admitted. To determine size, location and whether the stroke is ischemic or hemorrhagic, the nurse anticipates:
qs.ex: حسب البنك: الـ MRI بيحدد الحجم والمكان والنوع. (عملياً الـ CT أول حاجة).

qs.q: A carotid endarterectomy is considered for a patient with several TIAs. The nurse explains that it:
opts: Joins a superficial extracranial artery to an intracranial artery
Restores circulation after obstruction of a cerebral artery
Removes an atherosclerotic plaque in the carotid artery to prevent stroke
Opens a stenosis with a balloon and stent
qs.ex: الـ Carotid endarterectomy بيشيل البلاك من الشريان السباتي علشان يمنع الجلطة.

qs.q: The incidence of ischemic stroke in patients with TIAs is reduced with:
qs.ex: الـ Aspirin بجرعة صغيرة يومياً بيقلّل الـ stroke بعد الـ TIA.

qs.q: What is the priority intervention in the ED for the patient with a stroke?
opts: Maintenance of respiratory function with a patent airway and oxygen
qs.ex: الأولوية في الطوارئ: airway مفتوح وأكسجين.

qs.q: A ruptured cerebral aneurysm has been diagnosed. The nurse anticipates which treatment?
qs.ex: الـ Aneurysm المتمزق بيتعالج بالـ clipping أو الـ coiling.

qs.q: During the acute phase of a stroke, which cardiovascular sign is seen as the body attempts to increase cerebral blood flow?
qs.ex: في المرحلة الحادة الضغط بيعلى، علشان الجسم بيحاول يوصّل دم للمخ.

qs.q: During the secondary assessment of a patient with stroke, what should be included? (Select all that apply)
qs.ex: التقييم الثانوي فيه: حركة العين (gaze)، والإحساس، وشلل الوش، والـ proprioception، والحركة.

qs.q: Which nursing intervention is indicated for the patient with hemiplegia?
opts: Sling to immobilize the affected arm
Each joint lower than the proximal joint
Patient performs passive ROM of the affected limb with the unaffected limb
qs.ex: المريض يحرّك الطرف المشلول بالطرف السليم (passive ROM).

qs.q: A right-brain stroke patient has homonymous hemianopsia. Early in care the nurse should:
opts: Place objects on the right side within the field of vision
Place objects on the left side
qs.ex: جلطة في المخ اليمين بتضيّع المجال الشمال، فنحط الحاجات في الناحية اليمين اللي شايفها.

qs.q: Four days after a stroke a patient is to start oral feeding. Before feeding, the nurse should first:
qs.ex: قبل الأكل: نتأكد من الـ gag reflex علشان ميشرقش.

qs.q: What is an appropriate food for a stroke patient with mild dysphagia?
qs.ex: الـ dysphagia الخفيفة: أكل طري متماسك زي البيض المخفوق.

qs.q: A wife asks why her husband with hemorrhagic stroke did not receive tPA. Best response:
opts: He didn't arrive within the timeframe
Not everyone is eligible; has he had surgery?
The medication dissolves clots and could cause more bleeding in his brain
qs.ex: الـ tPA بيدوّب الجلطات، ولو اتدّى في النزيف هيزوّده.

qs.q: What is an appropriate intervention to promote communication in a patient with aphasia?
opts: Structure statements so no verbal response needed
qs.ex: مع الـ aphasia: نتكلم في حاجات يومية مألوفة.

qs.q: A right-hemisphere stroke patient has unilateral neglect. During rehabilitation the nurse should:
opts: Avoid positioning on the affected side
Place objects on the unaffected side
Teach the patient to care consciously for the affected side
Protect the affected side with pillows
qs.ex: الـ unilateral neglect: نعلّمه ياخد باله من الناحية المصابة بقصد.

qs.q: A patient with right-sided hemiplegia: what does the nurse teach the family about behavior changes?
opts: Provide directions verbally in small steps
qs.ex: حسب البنك: نشتت انتباهه بعيد عن ردود الفعل العاطفية غير المناسبة.

qs.q: The nurse helps the family cope with long-term effects of stroke by:
opts: Informing that the patient needs help with all ADLs
Encouraging family therapy or support groups
Helping them understand residual damage to promote problem solving
qs.ex: نساعد الأسرة يفهموا الضرر الدايم علشان يعرفوا يحلّوا المشاكل.

qs.q: Which intervention should the nurse delegate to the LPN when caring for a patient after acute stroke?
opts: Administer ordered antihypertensives and platelet inhibitors
qs.ex: الـ LPN يدّي أدوية الضغط ومضادات الصفائح المكتوبة. أما التقييم والتعليم فشغل الـ RN.

qs.q: The most common arrhythmia associated with stroke is:
qs.ex: أشهر arrhythmia مع الـ stroke هي Atrial fibrillation.

qs.q: What is the primary feature of a coma?
opts: Prolonged unconsciousness and failure to respond to stimuli
Loss of motor function in one side of the body
qs.ex: الغيبوبة: فقدان وعي طويل ومفيش استجابة للمؤثرات.

qs.q: Which of the following is a systemic cause of coma?
qs.ex: سبب جهازي (مش من المخ نفسه): Hepatic encephalopathy.

qs.q: Which central cause can lead to coma?
qs.ex: سبب مركزي: Stroke.

qs.q: What is the main presentation in the clinical diagnosis of coma?
qs.ex: أهم مظهر: نقص مستوى الوعي (DCL).

qs.q: Which of the following is commonly seen on a CT scan for coma diagnosis?
opts: Hemorrhage or edema in the brain
qs.ex: الـ CT بيبيّن نزيف أو ورم في المخ.

qs.q: Which laboratory test can suggest hepatic encephalopathy in a coma patient?
qs.ex: الأمونيا العالية: Hepatic encephalopathy.

qs.q: What could leukocytosis (elevated WBC count) indicate in a coma patient?
qs.ex: كرات الدم البيضا العالية: عدوى أو التهاب.

qs.q: What does a low T3 and T4 level in the thyroid profile suggest?
qs.ex: T3 وT4 واطيين: Myxedema coma.

qs.q: Elevated creatinine and urea levels in the kidney profile are indicative of:
qs.ex: الكرياتينين واليوريا العاليين: Uremic encephalopathy.

qs.q: Which condition may be suggested by elevated bilirubin levels in a coma patient?
qs.ex: البيليروبين العالي: مشكلة في الكبد.

qs.q: Which autoimmune profile finding suggests an increased risk of stroke?
qs.ex: الـ Anti-phospholipid antibodies بتزوّد خطر الجلطات.

qs.q: In coma management, what is the first step in conservative management?
qs.ex: أول خطوة: airway.

qs.q: Which of the following is a critical component of conservative management for bedridden coma patients?
qs.ex: العناية التنفسية أساسية للمريض الراقد.

qs.q: How should a bedridden coma patient be positioned to prevent complications?
opts: Position them in a sitting posture
Place them on their back permanently
qs.ex: نغيّر وضعه بانتظام علشان قرح الفراش.

qs.q: What is the recommended angle for the head of the bed in ventilated coma patients?
qs.ex: راس السرير 30–45°.

qs.q: What is the purpose of a "Ventilator Bundle" in coma management?
opts: To reduce the need for sedation
To prevent respiratory and circulatory complications
qs.ex: الـ Ventilator bundle بيمنع المضاعفات التنفسية والدورية.

qs.q: When is surgical decompression needed for coma patients?
opts: Only if the patient is in stable condition
When there is brain swelling, bleeding, or mass effect
qs.ex: الـ decompression لما يكون فيه ورم في المخ أو نزيف أو mass effect.

qs.q: What does a brain MRI with diffusion-weighted imaging primarily help diagnose in coma patients?
qs.ex: الـ DWI MRI بيشخّص الـ stroke بدري.

qs.q: What does a positive ANA test indicate in a coma patient?
qs.ex: الـ ANA الإيجابي: أمراض مناعة ذاتية زي الـ lupus.

qs.q: How can electrolyte imbalances contribute to coma?
qs.ex: اختلال الأملاح بيأثر على شغل المخ.

qs.q: What is the purpose of an echocardiogram in coma management?
qs.ex: الـ Echo بيقيّم القلب.

qs.q: In a coma patient, a CBC showing thrombocytosis or thrombocytopenia suggests:
qs.ex: زيادة أو نقص الصفائح: مشكلة نزيف أو التهاب.

qs.q: What does "ventilator bundle" refer to in the context of coma management?
opts: Measures for preventing respiratory and circulatory complications in ventilated patients
A medication plan for coma patients
A nutritional intervention for coma patients
qs.ex: إجراءات بتمنع المضاعفات عند مرضى الجهاز.

qs.q: In the management of coma patients, what is the role of oral care?
opts: To reduce the risk of infection
qs.ex: العناية بالفم بتقلّل العدوى (VAP).

qs.q: How does hypothyroidism contribute to coma?
opts: By causing myxedema coma due to low thyroid hormones
qs.ex: نقص الغدة الدرقية بيعمل myxedema coma.

qs.q: What is the significance of brain contusion in coma patients?
opts: It is a type of brain tumor
It results from traumatic brain injury and can lead to coma
It is an indication of systemic infection
qs.ex: الكدمة في المخ (contusion) من الإصابات وممكن تعمل غيبوبة.

qs.q: What condition is associated with elevated liver enzymes (AST, ALT) in coma patients?
qs.ex: إنزيمات الكبد العالية: Hepatic encephalopathy.

qs.q: What is the primary goal in the management of coma patients?
qs.ex: الهدف: نعالج السبب الأساسي.

qs.q: Which of the following is a key part of managing coma patients who are on mechanical ventilation?
opts: Keeping the patient sedated at all times
qs.ex: منع قرح الفراش جزء أساسي.

qs.q: A brain hemorrhage in a coma patient can lead to which of the following complications?
qs.ex: النزيف بيعمل ورم وضغط على المخ.

qs.q: Which of the following is a common sign of cardiogenic shock in ACS?
opts: Low blood pressure with signs of organ dysfunction
Lack of chest pain Acute Stroke:
qs.ex: الـ cardiogenic shock: ضغط واطي مع فشل في الأعضاء.

qs.q: What is the primary cause of ischemic stroke?
opts: Embolism from the left side of the heart or thrombus on the artery wall
Low oxygen levels in the brain
qs.ex: الـ ischemic stroke سببه embolus من الناحية الشمال للقلب، أو جلطة على جدار الشريان.

qs.q: Which of the following is a common symptom of Acute Stroke?
opts: Severe headache and disturbance of consciousness
Nausea and vomiting without any neurological deficits
qs.ex: حسب البنك: صداع شديد واضطراب في الوعي.

qs.q: Which imaging modality is used as the first step in diagnosing stroke to differentiate between ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke?
qs.ex: الـ CT أول خطوة علشان نفرّق بين الـ ischemic والـ hemorrhagic.

qs.q: What is the purpose of a Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWI) MRI in stroke diagnosis?
qs.ex: الـ DWI بيكشف الـ ischemia بدري.

qs.q: How does echocardiography contribute to stroke management?
opts: Identifies sources of embolism (e.g., LA appendage thrombus or LV smoke)
qs.ex: الـ Echo بيدوّر على مصدر الـ embolus في القلب.

qs.q: What is the significance of Duplex Ultrasound in stroke management?
opts: To assess for stenosis or blockages in carotid and basilar arteries
qs.ex: الـ Duplex بيشوف الضيق في الشرايين السباتية.

qs.q: What is the initial management approach for acute stroke patients?
opts: Keep the airway open and assess vital signs
qs.ex: أول حاجة: airway ونقيس العلامات الحيوية.

qs.q: Which medication is commonly used in medical management of ischemic stroke to prevent further clot formation?
qs.ex: الـ Aspirin أو الـ clopidogrel بيمنعوا جلطات جديدة.

qs.q: Within how many hours should thrombolytic therapy (e.g., tPA) be administered to ischemic stroke patients for optimal benefit?
qs.ex: الـ tPA خلال 3–4.5 ساعة من بداية الأعراض.

qs.q: What is the purpose of interventional thrombectomy in stroke management?
opts: To dissolve clots in smaller arteries
To remove a clot from a large blood vessel to restore blood flow
qs.ex: الـ Thrombectomy بيشيل الجلطة من شريان كبير.

qs.q: Which of the following procedures is used to treat brain aneurysms?
qs.ex: الـ Aneurysm بيتعالج بالـ coiling.

qs.q: What is the role of surgical decompression in stroke management?
opts: To remove a clot from an artery
To reduce brain swelling by removing part of the skull
To repair a damaged blood vessel
qs.ex: الـ Decompression بيشيل جزء من الجمجمة علشان يخفف الضغط.

qs.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of hemorrhagic stroke?
opts: Sudden severe headache and increase in intracranial pressure
No significant increase in intracranial pressure
Partial occlusion of a cerebral artery
qs.ex: الـ Hemorrhagic: صداع مفاجئ شديد وزيادة في ضغط المخ.

qs.q: What is a major complication associated with ischemic stroke that may require thrombolytic therapy?
qs.ex: حسب البنك: embolism من القلب.

qs.q: What is the significance of early administration of thrombolytic therapy in ischemic stroke?
opts: To restore blood flow and minimize brain damage
qs.ex: الـ thrombolytics بدري بترجّع الدم وبتقلّل الضرر.

qs.q: How does MRI with diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) aid in early detection of ischemic stroke?
opts: By identifying early tissue damage caused by reduced blood flow
By measuring oxygen levels in the blood
qs.ex: الـ DWI بيكشف ضرر الأنسجة بدري.

qs.q: What is the primary cause of ischemic stroke from the left side of the heart?
opts: Atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias causing embolism
qs.ex: الـ AF بيعمل جلطة في القلب الشمال وتطلع للمخ.

qs.q: Which of the following is a benefit of using anticoagulants such as aspirin or clopidogrel in ischemic stroke management?
qs.ex: مضادات الصفائح بتمنع جلطات جديدة.

qs.q: In which case would interventional thrombectomy be most appropriate for stroke patients?
opts: In patients with large vessel occlusion and ischemic stroke
qs.ex: الـ Thrombectomy مع انسداد شريان كبير.

qs.q: A patient with a TIA is at high risk for:
qs.ex: الـ TIA إنذار للـ stroke.

qs.q: Before giving thrombolytics for ischemic stroke, which finding must be reported?
qs.ex: قبل الـ thrombolytics لازم الضغط يبقى أقل من 185/110، فالضغط 195/110 لازم يتبلّغ.

qs.q: Select ALL signs of meningeal irritation.
qs.ex: علامات السحايا: تيبس الرقبة، وKernig، وBrudzinski، والحساسية من النور.

qs.q: A stroke patient with homonymous hemianopia should be taught to:
opts: Scan the environment by turning the head
qs.ex: يلف راسه ويمسح المكان بعينه.

qs.q: Before feeding a patient after stroke, the nurse first:
qs.ex: نشيك على الـ gag reflex.

qs.q: Myasthenia gravis is characterized by:
opts: Muscle weakness increasing with activity and improving with rest
qs.ex: الضعف بيزيد مع المجهود وبيتحسن مع الراحة.

qs.q: A patient with which of the following conditions would be identified by the nurse as experiencing a critical illness ?
opts: Post car accident whoseBP:124/74mmHg, P:74b/m, R:18br/min
Acute bronchospasm and whose BP: 100/60 mmHg, P: 124 b/m, R: 32 br/min
qs.ex: مريض عنده bronchospasm حاد، وضغطه 100/60، ونبضه 124، ونفسه 32: ده critical لأن حياته في خطر.

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. Tag the following patients using the TRIAGE code - The driver of the tractor trailer who has been ejected from the vehicle and is trapped under the wheels. His pupils are dilated, and he is pulseless and non breathing ( ...... )
qs.ex: مفيش نبض ولا نفس، والبؤبؤ موسّع: Black (متوفي).

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. An elderly woman who has no apparent injuries, but who is complaining of severe chest pain. She is pale and having obvious respiratory distress. ( ...... )
qs.ex: ست كبيرة عندها ألم صدر شديد، وشاحبة، ونفسها ضيق: Red، أولوية فورية.

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. A young woman who has bilateral lower limb bone injuries with limitation of movement ( ...... )
qs.ex: إصابات عضم في الرجلين ومش قادرة تتحرك، بس مستقرة: Yellow (متأخر).

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. An approximately 15-year-old female who is screaming that her leg hurts
qs.ex: الإجابة حسب البنك Red. حسب START لو مش قادرة تمشي وبتصرّخ من الألم ممكن تبقى yellow، بس اعرف إجابة البنك.

qs.q: Which of the following nursing diagnosis should receive the highest priority
opts: Impaired gas exchange related to increased blood flow
Fluid volume excess related to peripheral vascular disease
Risk for injury related to edema
Altered peripheral tissue perfusion related to venous congestion
qs.ex: حسب البنك: Altered peripheral tissue perfusion.

qs.q: Which of the following is the triage category you would allocate for a 15 year old patient, who arrived at the ED with a small laceration on his forehead He says that he can't move his legs Upon assessment, he had a RR of 20 bt/min, strong pulses, and capillary refill time of less than 2 seconds
qs.ex: جرح صغير بس مش قادر يحرّك رجليه (احتمال إصابة نخاع)، وعلاماته الحيوية مستقرة: Yellow.

qs.q: Triage' system is based upon the principle of treating
qs.ex: الـ Triage: نعالج المرضى حسب الأولوية.

qs.q: You would allocate which of the following triage tags for an elderly woman who is complaining of severe chest pain, pale and having obvious respiratory distress ?
qs.ex: ألم صدر شديد مع شحوب وضيق نفس: Red.

qs.q: Which of the following is a triage tags would be allocated for 75-year-old male with deep cuts to both forearms. Resp. rate 20. Capillary refill greater than 2secs. Alert and oriented
qs.ex: حسب البنك: جروح عميقة في الدراعين، فممكن نزيف وصدمة، فالإجابة Red.

qs.q: Which of the following is a triage tags would be allocated for a 34-year-old man who is unresponsive with exposed brain matters ?
qs.ex: مخ مكشوف ومبيستجيبش: Black (expectant).

qs.q: A patient is admitted to the emergency department with head trauma resulting from an accident. The patient opens both eyes to painful stimuli, makes incomprehensible sounds, and flexes to pain. Using the Glasgow Coma Scale, which score will the nurse document in the ?patient's medical record
qs.ex: بيفتح عينه للألم E2، وأصوات مش مفهومة V2، وبيثني لما يتألم (withdrawal) M4. المجموع 8.

qs.q: A catastrophic disaster has occurred 5 miles from the hospital you are working in. The hospital's disaster plan is activated and the wounded are brought to the hospital. You're helping triage the survivors. One of the wounded is able to walk around and has minor lacerations on the arms, hands, chest, and legs. You would place what color tag on this survivor?
qs.ex: بيمشي وجروحه بسيطة: Green.

qs.q: Which of the following is expected to occur during compensatory stage of shock?
opts: Decreased heart rate and cardiac contractility
Vasodilation to increase systemic vascular resistance
qs.ex: في المرحلة التعويضية للصدمة الجسم بيفرز ADH علشان يحتفظ بالميه.

qs.q: Which of the following interventions should the nurse consider for a patient who has been admitted with cardiogenic shock?
qs.ex: الـ Cardiogenic shock: نبدأ inotropes تقوّي انقباض القلب.

qs.q: Which of the following conditions can lead to obstructive shock?
qs.ex: الـ Cardiac tamponade بيعمل obstructive shock.

qs.q: When assessing a patient who is experiencing anaphylactic shock, which of the following could be an expected manifestation:
qs.ex: الـ Anaphylaxis بيعمل bronchospasm.

qs.q: While assessing chest sounds for a patient with cardiogenic shock, inspiratory crackles were heard, this may be due to:
qs.ex: الـ crackles في الـ cardiogenic shock معناها احتقان في الرئة.

qs.q: Which of the following is an assessment finding that will help the nurse to confirm a diagnosis of neurogenic shock?
qs.ex: الـ Neurogenic shock: نبض بطيء (45) مع ضغط واطي، لأن الـ sympathetic واقف.

qs.q: The first-line of treatment for a patient with anaphylaxis is to administer:
qs.ex: أول علاج للـ anaphylaxis هو Epinephrine. السؤال كان متداخل مع أسئلة تانية في الملف، وفضلنا آخر سؤال بس.

qs.q: In START triage, a patient who can walk is tagged:
qs.ex: اللي بيمشي: Green.

qs.q: The 'golden hour' refers to:
opts: The first hour after admission to ICU
The critical period after injury when definitive care improves survival
qs.ex: الـ Golden hour: الساعة الحرجة بعد الإصابة، لو المريض اتعالج فيها فرصه في النجاة أكبر.

qs.q: Select ALL components of the primary survey.
qs.ex: الـ Primary survey: Airway مع حماية الرقبة، وBreathing، وCirculation ووقف النزيف، وDisability، وExposure.

qs.q: Which type of shock is caused by cardiac tamponade?
qs.ex: الـ Cardiac tamponade: Obstructive shock.

qs.q: An expected finding in the compensatory stage of shock is:
qs.ex: في المرحلة التعويضية: إفراز ADH وسرعة في النبض.

qs.q: A black triage tag indicates:
qs.ex: الـ Black: متوفي أو expectant.

qs.q: The nurse is handling a client with a chest tube. Suddenly, the chest drainage system is accidentally disconnected, what is the most appropriate action for the nurse to take ?
opts: Secure the chest tube using a tape
Place the end of the chest tube in a container of normal sterile saline
Apply an occlusive dressing and notify the physician
qs.ex: لو الـ chest drain اتفصل: نحط طرف الأنبوبة في محلول ملح معقم، علشان يعمل water seal مؤقت ومايدخلش هوا.

qs.q: ...... is a sign of tension Pneumothorax
qs.ex: علامة الـ tension pneumothorax: انحراف القصبة (tracheal deviation).

qs.q: Which intervention should the nurse implement for a male client who has had a left- sided chest tube for six (6) hours and refuses to take deep breaths because it hurts too much?
opts: Medicate the client and have the client take deep breaths
Encourage the client to take shallow breaths to help with the pain
Explain that deep breaths do not have to be taken at this time
Tell the client that if he doesn't take deep breaths, he could die
qs.ex: مريض الـ chest tube رافض ياخد نفس عميق من الألم: نديله مسكّن ونخليه ياخد نفس عميق.

qs.q: The immediate management of tension pneumothorax is
opts: Chest tube placement in 7th intercostal space
Needle thoracentesis in the 2nd intercostal space
A three-sided dressing placement over chest tube
qs.ex: العلاج الفوري للـ tension pneumothorax: needle decompression في المسافة الضلعية التانية.

qs.q: The client is admitted to the emergency department with chest trauma. When assess- ing the client, which signs/ symptoms would the nurse expect to find that support the diagnosis of pneumothorax ?
qs.ex: إصابة الصدر: تمدد الرئة مش متساوي وضيق نفس.

qs.q: ...... causes mediastinal shift and compression of the lungs
qs.ex: الـ Tension pneumothorax بيزق الـ mediastinum وبيضغط على الرئة.

qs.q: The nurse assesses a patient with chest injury who had flail chest for which of the following most distinctive sign ?
qs.ex: الـ Flail chest: حركة الصدر عكسية (paradoxical).

qs.q: Nurse Ruth assessing a patient for tracheal displacement should know that the trachea will deviate toward the:
opts: Contralateral side in a simple pneumothorax
Affected side in a tension pneumothorax
qs.ex: القصبة بتميل بعيد عن الناحية المصابة (contralateral) في الـ hemothorax والـ tension.

qs.q: A patient is admitted with a left mid-axillary chest wound and extreme dyspnea, tachycardia and hypoxia. There is unequal rise and fall of the chest with absent breath sounds on the left side, and a "sucking" sound on inhalation and exhalation. Chest X-ray shows a pneumothorax. This patient is expected to have which type of pneumothorax?
qs.ex: جرح في الصدر بيطلّع صوت «شفط» مع النفس: Open pneumothorax.

qs.q: A client with a chest injury has suffered flail chest. The nurse assesses the client for which most distinctive sign of flail chest ?
qs.ex: الـ Flail chest: paradoxical movement.

qs.q: A patient was admitted to the ER after a motor vehicle accident with multiple fractured ribs. Respiratory assessment includes signs/symptoms of secondary pneumothorax, which includes which of the following ?
opts: Crackles over lung bases of affected lung
Tracheal deviation toward the affected lung
Sharp pleuritic pain that worsens on inspiration
Increased diaphragmatic excursion on side of rib fractures
qs.ex: كسور الضلوع: ألم حاد بيزيد مع الشهيق.

qs.q: A client reports left-sided chest pain after playing racquetball. The client is hospitalized and diagnosed with left pneumothorax. When assessing the client's left chest area, the nurse expects to identify which finding ?
opts: Absence of breath sounds on auscultation
qs.ex: الـ Pneumothorax: صوت التنفس غايب في الناحية دي.

qs.q: During percussion of the chest wall, hyperresonance suggests which of the following ?
qs.ex: الـ Hyperresonance في الـ percussion: pneumothorax (هوا).

qs.q: What type of pressure or painful stimuli should the nurse avoid in a post-traumatic brain injury patient who has sustained multiple fractures to the face and eyes who is unable to perform a motor command based on a verbal stimulus ?
qs.ex: مع كسور الوش: نتجنب الضغط فوق الحاجب (supraorbital).

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. A middle- aged man who has an open head injury with exposed brain tissue. He is displaying agonal respirations
qs.ex: مخ مكشوف ونفس احتضاري (agonal): Black.

qs.q: While working in the ED, the following four patients arrived at the same time. Indicate how to sort these patients utilizing triage categories:  (1) A patient with a cut wound in the forehead, mild pain in the left leg and can walk  (2) A patient with back & neck cyanosis, with abdominal stab wound & open skull fracture  (3) A patient with left femur open fracture, cold extremities, shallow breathing, & weak pulse  (4) A patient with severe bleeding, is fully conscious with a respiratory rate of 30 br./min
qs.ex: الترتيب: (3) نزيف وصدمة ونفس سطحي، Red أولاً. بعده (4) نزيف شديد بس واعي. بعده (1) بيمشي، Green. وفي الآخر (2) جرح في البطن وكسر جمجمة مفتوح وزرقان، Black. يعني 3, 4, 1, 2.

qs.q: A victim with which of the following conditions would be sorted using a GREEN triage ?
opts: Has abrasions on the whole left posterior leg
qs.ex: سحجات بس في الرجل: Green.

qs.q: A 50-year-old patient, who has bilateral fractured femurs, weak radial pulse and a respiratory rate of 24 br/min will be receive ...... triage tag
qs.ex: كسر في عضمتين الفخذ، ونبض ضعيف (صدمة)، ونفسه 24: Red.

qs.q: While working in the ED, the following four patients arrived at the same time. Indicate how to sort these patients .utilizing triage categories:  (1) A patient is laying supine complaining of inability to feel or move extremities  (2) A patient with open femur fracture that is bleeding profusely  (3) A patient with dislocated shoulder that is controlled by a tourniquet  (4) A patient with open skull fracture and exposed brain matter
qs.ex: الترتيب: (2) كسر فخذ مفتوح بينزف بشدة، Red. بعده (1) مش حاسس بأطرافه، احتمال إصابة نخاع. بعده (3) كتف مخلوع والنزيف متحكم فيه. وفي الآخر (4) مخ مكشوف، Black. يعني 2,1,3,4.

qs.q: Tracheal deviation, absent breath sounds on one side and hypotension suggest:
qs.ex: انحراف القصبة، وغياب الصوت في ناحية، وهبوط الضغط: Tension pneumothorax.

qs.q: Paradoxical chest movement is characteristic of:
qs.ex: الحركة العكسية: Flail chest.

qs.q: Select ALL signs of cardiac tamponade (Beck's triad).
qs.ex: الـ Beck's triad: هبوط الضغط، وانتفاخ أوردة الرقبة، وأصوات القلب مكتومة.

qs.q: Kehr's sign (left shoulder pain) after abdominal trauma suggests:
qs.ex: الـ Kehr's sign (ألم في الكتف الشمال) بعد إصابة البطن: تمزق الطحال.

qs.q: Continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber of a chest drain indicates:
qs.ex: فقاعات مستمرة في الـ water seal: فيه تسريب هوا.

qs.q: Priority for a patient with suspected spinal cord injury is:
opts: Immobilize the spine while maintaining airway (jaw thrust)
qs.ex: إصابة النخاع: نثبّت العمود الفقري ونفتح الـ airway بالـ jaw thrust.
